planets.name: K2-38 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-38 with a 10.6-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: K2-38 c was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around K2-38. Its orbit and size follow Toledo-Padrón et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
